Target to attain 3.6 GW of renewable energy capacity by 2035

industry: Energy > Oil, Gas & Consumable Fuels > Gas > Gas Transmission/Marketing

operating_notes.text: Natural gas marketing segment result fell to ₹3,077.58 Cr in FY26 from ₹7,446.28 Cr in FY25.
Petrochemicals segment posted a loss of ₹1,408.22 Cr in FY26 against ₹37.31 Cr in FY25.
Standalone borrowings rose to ₹17,414.29 Cr at 31 March 2026 from ₹13,576.76 Cr a year earlier.
During FY26, GAIL added approximately 2,000 km of pipeline network and achieved LPG transmission of 4.6 MMTPA.
FY26 gas transmission 122.18 MMSCMD; gas sales 104.21 MMSCMD; LPG transmission highest ever at 4,600 TMT.
Petrochemical plant utilisation 94% in FY26; polymers sold ~1,085 KTA (785 GAIL, 300 BCPL).
CBG sales ~88,174 MT in FY26; 6 CBG plants under construction with 95 TPD capacity.
